sections.text_helper: Section 56.7 "TIM9/TIM12 registers" in chapter 56 (General-purpose timers (TIM9/TIM10/TIM11/TIM12/TIM13/TIM14)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 2791.
sections.section_content:
Refer to Section1.2 for a list of abbreviations used in register descriptions.
The peripheral registers have to be written by half-words (16 bits) or words (32 bits). Read
accesses can be done by bytes (8 bits), half-words (16 bits), or words (32 bits).
